Type: glossy black articulated work lamp
Use: task light for working or reading at a desk; home office, study, bedroom
Style: industrial, retro, modern
Materials: glossy black lacquered steel shade, arms and round base, exposed metal springs, black cord
Colors: glossy black, silver springs
Shape: rounded dome shade with a pull knob on a jointed spring-balanced arm, heavy round base, angular and adjustable, compact
Feel: graphic, practical, classic, focused
Goes with: white or wood desks, black and white palettes, metal accents; industrial or modern home offices
